For the record

Tiebreakers & Postseason

Tiebreaker order

  1. Total wins in regulation and overtime (RW/OTW)
  2. Points earned in head-to-head competition between tied clubs
  3. Goal differential in all league games
  4. Goals for in all league games
  5. Coin flip held at the Poughkeepsie league office

2025-26 Postseason recap

The top four clubs qualified for the Lewis Cup playoffs as a best-of-five quarterfinal field. Roxbury swept Catskill 3-0 in the quarterfinals, downed Kingston 3-1 in the semis, then knocked off Beacon 4-2 in the Cup Final at Roxbury Memorial Arena on March 21. Forward Mateusz Kowalczyk took home Cup Final MVP honors with 4 goals and 7 assists across the playoff run.

Saugerties and New Paltz played the season's only relegation tiebreaker; both clubs return next year as the league has no relegation tier.

Cup history

  • 2026: Roxbury Roar def. Beacon Bluefins, 4-2
  • 2025: Beacon Bluefins def. Kingston Kingpins, 4-1
  • 2024: Roxbury Roar def. Catskill Crusaders, 4-3 (OT)
  • 2023: Kingston Kingpins def. Beacon Bluefins, 4-2
  • 2022: Catskill Crusaders def. Saugerties Steelheads, 4-0

Award winners

  • MVP: Mateusz Kowalczyk (ROX)
  • Top Scorer: Mateusz Kowalczyk (ROX), 90 pts
  • Top Goaltender: Liam McKenna (ROX), .934 SV%
  • Top D: Aleksander Petrov (CAT), 71 pts
  • Rookie of Year: Joaquín Cabrera (KGN)
  • Coach of Year: Greg Sokolowski (ROX)
